+"""Intent tests for risk.annualize (M1-T18, RISK-03, TC-06): daily vol scaled by sqrt(252)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pytest
+
+from risk import Returns, VolSeries, annualize
+
+
+def _returns(data: dict) -> Returns:
+    return Returns(
+        base_date=data["base_date"],
+        dates=tuple(data["dates"]),
+        tickers=tuple(data["tickers"]),
+        values={t: tuple(v) for t, v in data["values"].items()},
+    )
+
+
+def _vol(data: dict) -> VolSeries:
+    return VolSeries(
+        returns=_returns(data["returns"]),
+        window=data["window"],
+        annualized=data["annualized"],
+        values={t: tuple(v) for t, v in data["values"].items()},
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_tc06_each_value_scaled_to_trading_year_within_tolerance(golden):
+    data, expected = golden("risk", "TC-06")
+    vol = _vol(data["vol"])
+    result = annualize(vol)
+    assert set(result.values) == set(expected["values"])
+    for ticker, want in expected["values"].items():
+        got = result.values[ticker]
+        assert len(got) == len(want)
+        for g, w in zip(got, want, strict=True):
+            if w is None:
+                assert g is None
+            else:
+                assert g == pytest.approx(w, abs=expected["tol"])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_tc06_gaps_kept_as_none(golden):
+    data, expected = golden("risk", "TC-06")
+    result = annualize(_vol(data["vol"]))
+    for ticker, want in expected["values"].items():
+        gaps = [i for i, w in enumerate(want) if w is None]
+        assert gaps
+        assert [i for i, g in enumerate(result.values[ticker]) if g is None] == gaps
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_tc06_result_is_marked_annualized_and_keeps_returns_and_window(golden):
+    data, expected = golden("risk", "TC-06")
+    vol = _vol(data["vol"])
+    result = annualize(vol)
+    assert result.annualized is expected["annualized"]
+    assert result.returns == vol.returns
+    assert result.window == vol.window
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_annualizing_an_annualized_series_is_a_value_error(contract_sample):
+    vol = _vol(contract_sample("risk.VolSeries"))
+    assert vol.annualized is True
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=r"(?i)annuali"):
+        annualize(vol)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_annualizing_twice_is_a_value_error(golden):
+    data, _ = golden("risk", "TC-06")
+    once = annualize(_vol(data["vol"]))
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=r"(?i)annuali"):
+        annualize(once)
